activity_threshold.description: Only for agent types without session data (not opencode/claude): count the family as working while its process tree burns this much CPU. 100% = one full core.
activity_threshold.label: CPU fallback threshold (% of one core)

agents.description: Comma-separated process name fragments to watch (match is OR). E.g. opencode,claude,codex,gemini,aider,goose.
agents.label: Agent processes

heartbeat_timeout.description: Agent hooks report activity directly; a family stays lit this long after its last report. Covers quiet gaps between bursts.
heartbeat_timeout.label: Heartbeat memory (seconds)

notify.description: Show a notification when agents start or stop working.
notify.label: Notify on change

poll_interval.description: How often to sample agent CPU activity. Lower reacts faster, higher uses less CPU.
poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)

pulse.description: How fast the desktop glow breathes while agents work.
pulse.label: Pulse speed

session_timeout.description: A session counts as working while its transcript or database entry was touched within this long. Based on real agent data, not CPU.
session_timeout.label: Session freshness (seconds)

show_when_idle.description: Keep a dim indicator in the bar when no agents run. When off, the bar tile only appears while agents work.
show_when_idle.label: Show in bar when idle

started: Agents are working — wallpaper is live
title: Agent Glow
